description: This file defines the 'Answer' entity class for a Java application using JPA/Hibernate. It maps to the 'answers' table in the database and extends an audit model. The class includes fields for id, text, and a reference to a 'Question' entity, along with standard getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Entity class representing an answer with text content and a relation to a question, mapped to the 'answers' table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Updates the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates a Question entity with this answer.
